_comment: Sample stage-grind FSM showcasing the config schema. The PNGs in templates/example_game/ are placeholders so this file passes validation — replace them with real crops (tools/snap.py) before running. Run with --dry-run first.

home._note: absent_retries: tolerate 3 absent polls (~1s apart via absent_wait_ms) before concluding we're elsewhere — replaces hand-written home_2/home_3 retry-chain states.

battle._note: threshold: per-state override of the global match_threshold for a marker whose present/absent score margin is thin.

result._note: detect any-of: one state watches several templates (first found wins); dict-form on_match runs the branch of the template that matched — replaces chains of single-detect probe states.
